chunks: "Whoever shaves his head at Minā will have a light for every hair on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Minā, the hajj location where this rite is performed
key_terms.نُورٌ: light, a mark of reward and divine favor

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for shaving the head at Minā during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the spiritual merit of shaving the head at Minā during hajj. It promises a light on the Day of Judgment for every hair, highlighting the great reward attached to this ritual act of worship.
